dogecoin.text:
some dude invested his entire stimulus check in a meme coin and now he's trying to pay rent with dogecoin 

i think my friend just bought a house with money he made from selling solana nfts

i'm still waiting for my dogecoin dividends to buy a timeshare on the moon 

my solana wallet is now a museum of failed predictions

pontiacs are being dumped for dogecoin again 

funding rates are still in la la land

i'm now using my therapy sessions to pitch memecoins to my psychiatrist 

my student loan debt is somehow a good investment in dogecoin

my brain is a perpetual motion machine fueled by memecoins and existential dread 

i am simultaneously holding 100 bags of dogecoin and shorting the entire crypto market

i'm all in on a meme coin that's going to moon because of a tweet from a fake elon musk account

solana is the new dogecoin and i just bought 1000 sol 

the only thing that matters is bitcoin dominance and it's going to 100 percent

i'm still waiting for someone to invent a coin that rewards holders for losing their private keys 

my crypto portfolio is now being managed by a guy who thinks dogecoin is the new bitcoin

dogecoin is my love language 

i trade on animal instincts now

i'm still waiting for someone to explain why 99 percent of tokens are just copies of dogecoin with a different animal picture. 

most people in crypto have the financial literacy of a kindergartener playing with monopoly money.

i'm mentally preparing myself for a reality where every altcoin has its own sovereign nation state and we're all just diplomats negotiating trade deals with dogecoin somalia 

solana is the new switzerland and everyone's just trying to get their wealth out before the next bonk...

my market sentiments are filtered through a guy who thinks Dogecoin is a viable store of value

i have a hunch that my wallet is secretly a black hole for bad investment ideas

i'm dumping all my sol coins into a decentralized timeshare for a private jet that only flies over bitcoin mining facilities 

my wallet is now a ticking time bomb of unbridled meme potential waiting to annihilate the crypto market with an arsenal of dogecoin and shibarium...

i'm still holding 10k dogecoin from a poker game in 2018 

my book is down 90% this year and i don't care

i'm all in on the idea that some tokens are like musical genres and once they're played out nobody cares anymore 

people who still hold dogecoin are like those guys who still wear ed hardy t shirts unironically

my cat's bitcoin wallet has more funds than my retirement account

i'm starting to think the dogecoin millionaire is a viable career path

i'm watching a bunch of retards get zeroed on their favorite shitcoins 

hyperinflation is going to make all these worthless tokens look like dogecoin in 2021

i'm all in on this meme coin and my therapist says it's a cry for help 

i need to reevaluate my life choices after buying 1000 dollars worth of dogecoin

dogecoin investors are secretly geniuses 

my neighbor's parrot has a more diversified portfolio than most crypto traders

i'm still trying to figure out why my brain thinks dogecoin is a viable alternative to human relationships 

market sentiment is just a bunch of dudes on twitter screaming at each other about made up numbers 

the more i learn about decentralized finance the more i realize i...
